expected: A confirmed write is announced through Cluster.NotifyInstalled and converges the peer, a failure window returns ErrDumpFailed but still notifies while the retries follow the ladder, and the dump-notify scenario runs deterministically.
actual: NotifyInstalled is a lookup-only stub: no DataReplication reaches the peer, so node 1 holds no record in either the confirmation or the failure-window subtest. The load-skip and same-seed subtests pass because they do not depend on the announcement.
semanticAssessment: The target test executed and failed on its planned interaction assertions: the peer never received the confirmed or the failed-window record because the notification seam did not emit. Both failures are the exact behavior the GREEN implements (NotifyLocalWrite + route + drive, no Store.Set). No build, fixture or unrelated failure; the package compiled and the engine-over-cluster harness drove the Set confirmation at the exact virtual dump instant before the convergence assertion failed.
